description: Use first when a user asks a gear question in plain words, such as "best power rack under $500 for a 7 ft ceiling", "quiet cardio for an apartment", "walking pad for a 300 lb person", "folding squat rack, no drilling" or "cheapest adjustable dumbbells". Reads the budget, ceiling height, user height and weight, noise, apartment, folding and no-drilling hints from the question and returns ranked picks, each with plain reasons built only from Strong Saga guide data (the guide #1 pick, who it is for, price, ceiling fit, capacity, noise and apartment lines from the guide). Shows what it understood, any assumption it made (for example "low ceiling" read as 84 in), and an equivalent search URL. Show buy_url to users exactly as given: it is a strongsaga.com/go/ link that opens the retailer. For a whole set within a budget and room, use build_home_gym instead. When the question names the topic of a Strong Saga guide (e.g. "best walking pad for tall people"), from_guide returns that guide's own ranked list in order. If no Strong Saga guide covers the gear asked about, not_covered says so and picks is empty: tell the user that instead of suggesting unrelated gear.

q.description: The question in plain words, 3 to 300 characters. Include budget, ceiling height, body weight, noise or apartment needs when known.

user_height_in.description: User height in inches for treadmill and walking pad ceiling math (default 70). Also read from the question, e.g. "6 ft 2".
